name: Littlestone Dimension / Worst Mistakes
details: For finite classes, the unrestricted tree rank defining Littlestone dimension dominates the regular-tree rank defining worst mistakes.
proof: The worst-sequence/offline characterization maximizes the rank only over class trees induced by a fixed ordered sequence of instances: every depth level has one common queried instance.  Each such regular class tree is a valid Littlestone tree, while Littlestone dimension maximizes over all instance-labeled class trees.  Maximizing over the larger family gives $\mathrm L\geq\mathrm M_{\mathrm{worst}}$.
